# FG-AIASSET-0001

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_asset_repo_with_a_latest_model_is_ai_asset_invalid` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: AI 資産（スキル・プレイブック・モデル・評価ケースなど）が規則に合っていません。一覧のファイル・行・理由を直してください。
- en: The AI assets (skills, playbooks, models, evaluation cases, ...) break a rule. Fix the listed files, lines and reasons.
- id: Aset AI (skill, playbook, model, kasus evaluasi, ...) melanggar aturan. Perbaiki berkas, baris, dan alasan yang dicantumkan.

## 原因 (cause)

Plan 17 P17-3 (ADR-0035): the AI asset lint (forge_doc::ai_asset::lint, `gstn ai-asset lint`, run by the CI job of a repository whose `ai_assets.enabled` is on) found a problem. Each problem is `path:line rule [subject]` (line 0: the whole file, or a TOML file whose subject names the table and key); `rule` is stable. Reading: too_large (over 256 KiB), not_utf8, toml_syntax, symlink_not_followed, not_utf8_name; the skill front matter (`skills/<name>.md`, PFS pe-*.md keys): front_matter_missing, front_matter_unclosed, the strict YAML refusals (syntax, yaml_anchor, yaml_alias, yaml_tag, duplicate_key, ...), front_matter_not_a_mapping, key_unknown, field_missing, field_invalid, skill_name_invalid, skill_name_mismatch (name is not the file name), axis_invalid, process_kind_missing, date_invalid, profile_invalid (not full / forms / core / forwarder); playbooks (`playbooks/*.toml`, `[[playbook]]` = one me_ai_playbook row): key_unknown, field_missing, field_invalid, scope_type_invalid, severity_invalid, date_invalid, profile_invalid, playbook_duplicate; agents (`agents/<name>.toml`, optional until PFS-8): agent_name_mismatch, field_invalid (allowed_tools); tools (`tools/tools.toml`, optional): tool_duplicate; models (`models/models.toml`): models_empty, model_latest (no tag or `latest`), model_digest_missing (not `@sha256:<64 hex>`), model_ref_invalid; bench (`bench/bench.toml`): image_not_pinned; across files: skill_unknown (a playbook names a skill that does not exist), agent_unknown, tool_unknown, tool_not_allowed (a playbook's tool or a skill's required tool is not in the agent's allowlist), profile_too_low (the playbook's edge profile is below a skill's, a tool's or the agent's), skill_process_mismatch (a process skill outside its process_kind scope); cases (`evals/cases/<anomaly_class>/<id>.json`): case_path_invalid, case_id_mismatch, case_class_mismatch, case_kind_invalid / case_kind_mismatch (a security case is `safety`), source_hash_invalid (a replica without the 64-hex hash of the judgment id), classification_invalid, field_missing (id, anomaly_class, kind, expected), case_raw_data with the kind as subject, found in the raw lines and in the decoded JSON (absolute_timestamp — dates with -, / or ., epoch numbers under date-like keys; ip_address — IPv4 or IPv6; plant_code — anything but P9xx; free_text, person — keys in any case; provenance — not replica / synthetic; confidential; duplicate_key at any depth; not_json — a .jsonl case is one object per line). Every file under evals/ but .md, .gitkeep and evals/baselines/ is a case (extensions in any case); threshold_not_proposal (anything under thresholds/ but thresholds/proposals/*.md). At most 200 problems, then too_many_problems; a subject is cut to 96 characters and never holds a matched value. Not a server fault: the files are the repository's content.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Run `gstn ai-asset lint --json` in the asset repository: each problem's path, line, rule and subject. The formats and rules are in docs/adr/0035-ai-asset-lint.md and crates/forge-doc/README.md. A case_raw_data problem is also the forge/risk stop `ai_case_raw_data` on the merge request.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct the listed files: pin models as name:tag@sha256:<digest>, name only existing skills and allowed tools in playbooks, raise the playbook's required_profile or choose another skill, and rebuild a case from the synthetic replica exporter (relative times, P9xx plants, pseudonyms, provenance replica with source_hash) instead of editing raw data out by hand.
